title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: add a small, opinionated set of RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to make it easier for engineers to onboard to agent workflows and to exercise our tool-calling APIs. This PR bundles: 1) three RAG agent templates (faq-bot, docs-assistant, and sales-assistant) with parameterized tool stubs; 2) two tool-calling quickstarts (http-search and calendar-integration) with runnable examples in redwood-examples; 3) docs site pages and quickstart landing content; and 4) a small test harness and CI job to validate examples build. Checklist: - [x] Add agent templates under redwood-examples/rag/templates - [x] Add tool-calling examples and README with step-by-step quickstarts - [x] Wire docs site pages and sidebar entries - [x] Add CI example build and lint checks - [x] Add brief eval prompt sets for template smoke tests Changes are intentionally small in each file to keep review focused on usage and copy. See related Linear tickets ENG-1124 (RAG quickstarts) and PM-321 (docs PRD). Testing: examples validated locally and via CI job which initially failed on a missing example dependency (fixed in second commit). No runtime/inference code changes. Backwards compatibility: purely additive docs and examples; no breaking changes. Merge strategy: squash merge after approvals and green CI.
